Hi Alex (and Sara),

Thanks again for taking the time today — really helpful conversation. Quick recap of what we covered and the areas where Redwood could help SpruceTech: 

• Use case: low-latency product recommendations in the mobile app (90th percentile < 200ms target)
• Primary constraint: cost per 1M requests needs to fit within existing infra budget (team target: < $X/month)
• Data modalities: user event streams + product metadata; no PII in payloads
• Success metric: A/B lift on CTR and decrease in latency for search-derived recommendations

Next steps I suggested on the call: a short pilot (2–4 weeks) using Redwood Dedicated with a focused experiment on 1–2 catalog segments; we'll provide a simple eval harness and a cost/latency projection.

Can you do me a favor and give a quick candid sense of fit on a 1–5 scale (1 = not a fit, 5 = very close), and whether the pilot path above sounds useful? If yes, I can send a one-page mutual action plan and 15-minute calendar options.

Attachment: discovery notes with call highlights and initial proposal.

Looking forward — thanks again.

Best,
